validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: confirmed real and under construction. Three independent sources agree this is Aramco MGS-3 Package 8 = two new 56-inch east-west gas pipelines (lines 3 and 4) from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10. MEED (Aramco-selects-contractors): 'Package 8 - Larsen & Toubro Energy Hydrocarbon (India). Laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-8 to EWPS-10, covering 480km.' L&T's own 2024-03-14 press release: EPC of 'two new 56" Pipelines ... running parallel to the existing pipeline corridor' for 'a prestigious client in the Middle East.' Pipeline Journal (L&T-completes...) Sep 2025: 'finished the EPC for a 120-kilometer stretch of 56-inch pipeline ... part of the extensive MGS Package 8 project ... Saudi Aramco's Master Gas System (MGS) Expansion Phase 3 ... ~4,000 km of new pipelines ... teams now mobilized on a subsequent 241-kilometer pipeline section.' Not GEM-derived. CLASSIFICATION: confirmed correct - dry-gas transmission trunk (East-West Pipeline / Master Gas System), 56-inch, gathering/process not implied. DUPLICATE: P6727 (line '3') and P6728 (line '4') are the two parallel lines of the same package; this is the expected GEM pair, NOT an erroneous duplicate - keep both but ensure their specs track one another. ATTRIBUTION: Aramco owner/operator confirmed by MEED + L&T + Pipeline Journal. Diameter 56-in confirmed by all three. Status=construction confirmed (L&T completing sections through 2025; full program target 2028). Start 2028 consistent with MGS-3 program completion target. SPEC CONCERN - LENGTH: GEM records 190 km for line 3 (and 190 km for line 4). No independent source corroborates 190 km/line. The GEM-cited MEED page gives 480 km for the pair (=>~240 km/line), and L&T reports building it as a 120 km stretch + a 241 km section. 190 km matches none of these and 190+190=380 != 480. The 190 km is an unsupported GEM apportionment - treat as a spec caveat, not a confirmed value.
